Record Class WildcardTypeName

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
be.imgn.gaia.processing.source.WildcardTypeName
Record Components:
upperBound - the bound of ? extends, if any; never Object, which a wildcard does not need
lowerBound - the bound of ? super, if any
annotations - the type annotations
All Implemented Interfaces:
TypeName
public record WildcardTypeName(@Nullable TypeName upperBound, @Nullable TypeName lowerBound, List<Annotation> annotations) extends Record implements TypeName
The name of a wildcard type argument: ?, ? extends T or ? super T.

      public WildcardTypeName(@Nullable TypeName upperBound, @Nullable TypeName lowerBound, List<Annotation> annotations)
      Creates the name.
      Parameters:
      upperBound - the bound of ? extends, if any; Object without annotations is dropped, so that ? extends Object is ?
      lowerBound - the bound of ? super, if any
      annotations - the type annotations
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if there are both bounds, or a bound is primitive

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
